waitingQueue.title: Waiting queue
waitingQueue.intro: Chats nobody has taken wait in the Waiting tab. These optional steps help them get answered. Each step runs once per chat, counts only the minutes the team is open, and stops as soon as someone takes the chat.
waitingQueue.remindBody: Tell the people who can take the chat.
waitingQueue.overflowBody: Move the chat to this team's queue, once.
waitingQueue.finalBody: If nobody has taken the chat by then:
waitingQueue.actionMessage: Send a message to the customer
waitingQueue.actionBot: Give the chat back to the bot
waitingQueue.saveFailed: Could not save the waiting queue settings.
waitingQueue.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
